title: Security · altered checkout request
description: Fictional defensive review of a request altered by the client.
case: Fictional defensive review. The trusted server record requires payment of 49.90. The received request changes the amount to 0.01, changes the action to refund and adds role=admin. The client cannot grant itself an admin role. Server policy requires rejecting execution whenever the received amount or action differs from the trusted record. No website request is executed.

evidence_schema.name: trusted_amount
evidence_schema.description: Amount in the trusted server record

evidence_schema.name: client_can_grant_admin
evidence_schema.description: The client may grant itself an admin role

decisions.instructions: How should the server handle this altered request?

criteria.0: Reject execution and investigate the mismatch
criteria.1: Execute the modified request without checks
criteria.2: Trust the admin role supplied by the client
